synthesis_prose: Netlify presents a clear message backed by consistent external coverage. Press and encyclopedic sources reinforce its serverless positioning. Its owned messaging emphasizes the builder experience without marketing-speak. Main tension: strong presence but still-limited differentiation versus alternatives.
